subject: C-CODE-07 observables k_invalid COMMITTED_CORRUPT pending
body:
TASK: C-CODE-07 observables for ASTRA status mapping. STATUS: CANDIDATE. C emits conditions only; no final epistemic status decided in SPEAR/Q*/FEM.

New/changed C observables (B owns mapping; A does not define it):
1) SPEAR k_invalid: query K contract violated (k_soft==0 || k_hard==0 || k_hard>K_HARD_MAX). Fail-closed: admitted_count=0, tie_overflow=0, candidates still scored. k_soft>k_hard is NOT invalid (K=min per frozen contract). Suggested class: configuration/contract fault, not UNKNOWN, not TIE-R0.
2) SPEAR ID_OUT_OF_ACTIVE_RANGE (replaces ID_UPPER_NONZERO): candidate_ref > loaded profile active_id_max -> candidate dropped, invalid_count++. Defensive re-check only (A-ID-PROFILE-01); authoritative checker is T1 directory admit. B owns the Manifest/ABI field carrying active_id_bits/active_id_max; please retarget R1 04.2 24 significant bits to the profile parameter.
3) FEM COMMITTED_CORRUPT (recover_state=3) + integrity_fault=1: COMMIT magic present AND prototype CRC invalid on recovery. No roll-forward, no raw retirement, nothing written. Never silently OLD_VALID, never UNKNOWN.
4) Q* pending-credit (candidate law, needs your confirmation): at most one unresolved TRAIN proposal. Second proposal while pending -> REFUSED (prop_refused=1, prop_refused_count++), no overwrite. Consumed on APPLIED / NOT_EXECUTED / EXAM_FROZEN / ILLEGAL_EXEC; KEPT on REWARD_NOT_ACCEPTED (so a correctly identified reward may be retried). R_NO_PROPOSAL = no state change. Duplicate reward after APPLIED -> R_NO_PROPOSAL, no second credit.
   Question for B: is keep-pending on REWARD_NOT_ACCEPTED legal under your reward-acceptance law, or must it consume?
5) Identity: Q* holds no proposal_id; episode_id/step_id/command_id remain action-lane authority (05.6). Confirm no second identity law is wanted in Q*.

Spec: 10_LEARNING_AND_STRATEGY.md 1.4-candidate (10.7 K contract + profile check, 10.8.4 pending protocol), 11_FAILURE_EXPERIENCE_MEMORY.md 1.4-candidate (11.12.1 wording, 11.12.3 COMMITTED_CORRUPT). Published to PACKAGE CANON_BLUEPRINT.
